 NBC NIGHTLY NEWS WITH TOM LLAMAS WINS WEDNESDAY IN BOTH KEY DEMOS AS LLAMAS ANCHORED FROM IOWA
 Oct 27, 2026 
 Dominique Donahue 
 Share This Post 
 Share on LinkedIn 
 Share on Twitter 
 Share on Facebook 
 Featured , NBC Nightly News 
 ‘Nightly News’ Dominates Evening News Competition in A25-54 & A18-49 Growth 
 Marks Largest Demo Audiences in 8 Months, Delivers 1 million A25-54 Viewers for 11 of the last 12 weeks 
 WEEK OF OCTOBER 19 HIGHLIGHTS 
 Nightly News ranked #1 in the key A25-54 and A18-49 demos on Wednesday, topping ABC by + 63,000 in A25-54 and + 43,000 in A18-49
 Llamas anchored from Iowa last Wednesday, where he interviewed both candidates in the senate race
 Nightly News dominates evening news competition in demo growth vs. last year and week
 Nightly News posts its largest demo audiences in 8 months 
 Nightly News marks 38 weeks of across-the-board growth vs. last year
 Nightly News surpasses 1 million A25-54 viewers in 11 of the last 12 weeks 
 Nightly News delivers its best streak of year-over-year growth on record 
 Nightly News is the #3 most-watched program in all of TV last week in total viewers, averaging 6.7 million total viewers, excluding specials, sports & syndication
 WEEK OF OCTOBER 19 STATS 
 Averages 6.7 million total viewers, topping CBS by +2.094 million (+45%) 
 Increases total viewership vs. last year by +83,000 and last week by +878,000
 Averages 1.11 million A25-54 viewers, beating CBS by +419,000 (+61%) 
 Increases A25-54 viewers vs. last year by +304,000 and last week by +89,000
 Narrows A25-54 gap vs. ABC by 24% vs. last year, 22% vs. last week
 Averages 809,000 A18-49 viewers, beating CBS by +325,000 (+67%) 
 Increases A18-49 viewers vs. last year by +303,000, last week by +54,000
 Narrows the A18-49 demo gap vs. ABC by 58% vs. last year, 39% vs. last week
 WEEK OF 10/19/2026 (with one day of data remaining) 
 Note: Nightly News was based on a 3-day average (Mon, Wed, Thu), retitled on Tuesday due to NBA impact and on Friday. ABC World News Tonight and CBS Evening News were also retitled on Friday. 
 Program P25-54 P18-49 P2+ 
 Imps Imps Imps 
 NBC NIGHTLY NEWS 1,107 809 6,720 
 CBS EVENING NEWS 688 484 4,626 
 ABC WORLD NEWS TONIGHT 1,198 863 8,837 
 Source: Nielsen Big Data + Panel, L+SD, Week of 10/19/2026 through Thursday, 10/22/2026. Average audience based on regularly-titled telecasts only. 
 ###
 NBC NIGHTLY NEWS WITH TOM LLAMAS  MARKS LARGEST OCTOBER DEMO AUDIENCES IN FOUR YEARS 
 Marks Closest A18-49 Gap vs. ABC for an October in 7 Years 
 Posts 8-Month High in A25-54, Most-Watched October in 3 Years in Total Viewers 
 Delivers 9 Consecutive Months of Year-Over-Year Growth 
 October 2026: Ratings Highlights 
 Nightly News   delivers its largest October A25-54 & A18-49 audiences in 4 years
 Nightly News  posts its biggest October total viewer audience in 3 years with 6.6 million total viewers
 Nightly News  delivers its closest A18-49 gap for October in 7 years vs. ABC
 Nightly News  marks an 8-month high in the key demo and 9 consecutive months of year-over-year growth 
 October 2026: Nightly Stats 
 Averages 6.6 million total viewers, topping CBS by + 2.301 million (+53%) 
 Nightly News  increases total viewers by +904,000 vs. last year, +24,000 vs. last month
 Narrows total viewer gap vs. ABC by 3% vs. last year
 Biggest October audience in 3 years
 Averages 1.04 million A25-54 viewers, beating CBS by +401,000 (+63%) 
 Nightly News  increases A25-54 viewers by +259,000 vs. last year, +10,000 vs. last month
 Biggest October audience in 4 years
 Averages 746,000 A18-49 viewers, beating CBS by +282,000 (+61%) 
 Nightly News increases A18-49 viewership vs. last year by +227,000
 Biggest October audience in 4 years
 Narrows A18-49 gap vs. ABC by 2% vs. last year
